accessibility:
- The `label` prop is automatically associated with the inner text input (`htmlFor` plus a generated `id`, or your own `id` if you pass one). While the label is wired it also names the input; without one, the input falls back to `aria-label="Add tag"`.
- A user-supplied `id` is applied to the inner input (the labellable control), not the wrapper div.
- When `maxTags` is reached the text input is not rendered, so the label renders without a `for` attribute.
- Tags are keyboard navigable
- Delete buttons have proper `aria-label`
- Autocomplete dropdown follows ARIA listbox pattern
summary: The `Taginput` component provides a tag/chip input field for managing multiple tags.

parts.summary: The `Taginput` component provides a tag/chip input field for managing multiple tags.

props.name: label
props.description: Field label. Automatically associated with the text input via `htmlFor` — uses your `id` when provided, otherwise a generated one. Not wired when the tag limit is reached (the input is not rendered) and dropped inside an outer `Field`.

props.name: labelProps
props.description: Props for the label element. An explicit `htmlFor` here overrides the automatic association (no id is generated then).

props.name: id
props.description: Applied to the inner text input (the labellable control), not the wrapper div.

props.name: field
props.description: Object property to use as display field.

props.name: allowNew
props.description: Allow creating new tags not in suggestions.

props.name: removeOnKeys
props.description: Remove tag on backspace. Default: true.

props.name: confirmKeys
props.description: Keys to confirm tag creation. Default: ['Enter', ','].

props.name: closable
props.description: Show close button on tags. Default: true.

props.name: rounded
props.description: Applies rounded corners to the tags.

props.name: ellipsis
props.description: Truncates long tag text with ellipsis.

props.name: hasCounter
props.description: Shows a counter of the number of tags.

props.name: onPasteSeparators
props.description: Characters that split pasted text into tags.

props.name: beforeAdding
props.description: Validation function called before adding a tag.

props.name: createTag
props.description: Custom function for creating tag objects from input.

props.name: keepFirst
props.description: Keeps the first autocomplete suggestion highlighted.

props.name: keepOpen
props.description: Keeps the autocomplete dropdown open after selection.

props.name: ariaCloseLabel
props.description: ARIA label for tag close buttons.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon name for the input field.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name. When set, one hidden input per tag is rendered.

props.name: form
props.description: Optional id of the form the hidden inputs belong to.

props.name: labelSize
props.description: Size for the label (used in horizontal layouts).

props.name: fieldClassName
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the Field wrapper.

extraProps.name: ref
extraProps.description: Ref forwarded to the input element.
